report.summary:
Patient P-D005 (34, female, commercial employer HMO with no transport benefit, home tract 17031241400). Social-needs screener (2026-10-22) reports no current transportation problem and no utilities shutoff risk, and today's visit transcript had no transport or utilities concerns. Nonetheless, here are community resource options for the two requested needs, with eligibility notes.

Utilities:
- Lakeside Energy Assistance (http://127.0.0.1:32927/pages/A6-03): energy bill assistance; page contained only a clinic-registration instruction (fuzzball workflow), no patient-facing eligibility or phone details available.
- Shutoff Prevention Clinic (http://127.0.0.1:32927/pages/B-utilities-2): walk-in help with disconnection notices, Tuesdays. Eligibility: not specified; appears open to anyone with a shutoff notice.
- Neighborhood Energy Help (http://127.0.0.1:32927/pages/B-utilities-1): income-based help with gas and electric bills; apply in person Mon/Wed. Eligibility: income-based (specific thresholds not listed).

Transport:
- Senior Shuttle West (http://127.0.0.1:32927/pages/B-transport-2): free rides to medical appointments weekdays 7 AM–5 PM. Eligibility: adults 60+ — patient is 34, so NOT eligible.
- Paratransit Info Desk (http://127.0.0.1:32927/pages/B-transport-3): apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions up to 21 days. Eligibility: ADA-qualifying disability (not documented for this patient).
- Medicaid Ride Line (http://127.0.0.1:32927/pages/B-transport-1): Medicaid plan members call number on card ≥2 business days ahead. Eligibility: Medicaid only — patient has commercial HMO, so NOT eligible.

No phone numbers were listed in the resource pages. One upcoming appointment (appt:2, primary care, today 10/22 8:30 AM, kept) was already attended; no future transport barrier identified from today's transcript.
